Keys on this phone
The keys that protect this app\'s data on this phone, and where each one lives. No key can be copied out of the phone.

What the app lock protects: your files and attachments need the system prompt for their keys. Your records are only hidden behind the lock screen. They are not encrypted by the app lock. Android\'s own encryption protects them while the phone is locked.

resources.string: The app also locks when the phone\'s screen turns off with the app on it, and after Android stopped the app. If you switch to another app and then turn the screen off, the app may stay unlocked until the time you chose has passed. Choose \"When it leaves the screen\" if it must lock every time.
Notifications
Show the text in notifications
While this is off, a notification shows only its kind, such as \"Reminders\", and no text.
Screenshots and recent apps
Hide in recent apps and block screenshots
Every screen of this app then blocks screenshots and screen recording, and shows blank in the list of recent apps. While the app lock is on, the app shows blank in the list of recent apps anyway.
Later
OK
The app lock was reset
The phone\'s screen lock was removed, so the app lock is off. The files of this app stay closed until you enter your 24 recovery words. Records, sync and reminders go on.
The app lock is off
The app lock was turned off, because the phone\'s screen lock was removed. Your files are still open. Set a screen lock, then turn the app lock on again.
Turn on the app lock
With the app lock on, this app asks for your fingerprint, or your phone\'s PIN, pattern or password, before it shows anything.
Files and attachments are encrypted with a key that needs this. Your records are not encrypted by the app lock. They are only hidden behind the lock screen.

Read this first. If the phone\'s screen lock is removed, Android deletes the key of the app lock. Then only your 24 recovery words open this app\'s files on this phone again. If you have also lost the words, these files can never be opened again on this phone.
Next, confirm that it is you. Then enter four of your recovery words from your paper. This shows that your paper copy exists.
Next, enter all 24 words from your paper. This phone does not keep your recovery key, so this is how the app checks your paper. The words are not kept here.
I understand, continue
Confirm that it is you. Then the app asks for four of your words.
